governance.guidance: Use keyword-to-URL mapping and editorial approval
Retain existing URLs; use redirects only when necessary; compare pre/post GSC data
Remove mandatory $9 payment from enquiry flow; paid add-ons remain optional
Do not claim certifications, lab testing, origin, MOQ, shipping time or health benefits unless verified
Publish only when unique local buyer value exists; avoid doorway pages
Use unique content, internal links, structured data and clear B2B intent
Track country, landing page, product, form start, form submit, qualified lead and add-on purchase
Create crawlable expert content, citations, entity consistency, llms.txt where appropriate, and structured data
